description: This line plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of a Whisper model across six epochs, comparing four different weight quantization configurations: small AdaLoRA_int4, small AdaLoRA_int8, small int4, and small int8. The x-axis represents the epoch number, ranging from 0 to 6 on a linear scale, with tick labels appearing at integer intervals. The y-axis represents the WER, scaled linearly from 25.0 to 42.5, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2.5. The 'small AdaLoRA_int4' configuration is depicted by a solid orange line with circular markers, starting at a WER of approximately 35.6 at epoch 0 and decreasing to about 30.1 at epoch 6. The 'small AdaLoRA_int8' configuration is shown as a dashed orange line with square markers, beginning at a WER of approximately 35.6 at epoch 0, peaking at around 42.3 at epoch 2, and ending at approximately 31.2 at epoch 6. The 'small int4' configuration is represented by a dotted orange line with diamond markers, starting at a WER of approximately 30.0 at epoch 0 and decreasing to about 25.0 at epoch 6. The 'small int8' configuration is shown as a dash-dotted orange line with triangular markers, starting at a WER of approximately 30.0 at epoch 0, decreasing to approximately 25.0 at epoch 6, and exhibiting a slight dip around epoch 4 before rising slightly again.
